note: The canonical Rub3Factory per chain: the single address that gives "deployed through the factory" a verifiable referent. Nothing is deployed to a public network yet, so every entry below is unpopulated. `null` is the ONLY marker for that, in every field: there is deliberately no placeholder address, no zero address and no TBD string anywhere in this file, so no value here can be mistaken for a deploy. A consumer MUST read a null `factory` as "this chain has no canonical factory" and MUST NOT substitute any other address. Validated by scripts/check-deployments.sh, which CI runs. See contracts/contracts.md -> Deploying through the factory.

fields.name: Human-readable chain name, matching the [rpc_endpoints] key in contracts/foundry.toml.
fields.factory: The canonical Rub3Factory address on this chain, 0x-prefixed and EIP-55 checksummed. null until deployed.
fields.deploy_block: The block the factory was deployed in, so an indexer starts there rather than at genesis. null until deployed.
fields.generation: 1-based position in the factory's immutable previousFactory chain: 1 is the first factory on this chain (previousFactory == 0x0), 2 is the factory that supersedes it, and so on. null until deployed.
